statement: A current five-case TypeScript replay bounded six authored variants against the exact furnace target. Downstream etch-to-ALD coverage recovery after 10 s changed no furnace shortage and regressed current cases by 0.000150; after 5 s changed no furnace shortage, added 2.837567 average WIP equivalent in the driver, and regressed a case by 2.837544; after 1 s removed only 1.000 s of furnace shortage, added the same WIP, and regressed a case by 2.916394. The historical 19/20 always-cycle control removed 0.750 s but regressed a case by 9.306028. The historical five-second input-queue recovery removed 1.000 s and improved aggregate score but still regressed lithography-interruption by 0.000099. No tested control both reduces the exact target and satisfies uniform zero current-best regression.
